# Contributing to MLP OS Archive

The archive welcomes My Little Pony-themed independent operating systems with
their own kernels, Linux distributions, and desktop themes or customizations.
Historical, discontinued, unfinished, and experimental projects are eligible.

- To suggest a project, open the [issue form chooser](https://github.com/Evan-Windproof/MLP-OS-collect/issues/new/choose)
  and pick your language. A project name, category, short description, and at
  least one public source URL are sufficient to begin review.
- To add or improve a project record directly, follow the
  [project submission guide](../docs/PROJECT_SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md) and open a
  pull request against `main`.

Use the original language for source material and project titles. Translations
are welcome when available. Share material that can be discussed publicly and
credit the original creators.

An issue is a proposal. Maintainers review evidence, ask for missing information
when needed, and use a pull request to add an accepted record. A record can be
published with incomplete verification as long as its status and claims reflect
the evidence. See the guide for the verification criteria and publication steps.
